extraction.Name: Charles Deroin
extraction.Recorded patent: Was it filed for record? No
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land was sold to John Know for $4000 but when deed signed to Know, he gave allottee $10 applied bal. to debts
extraction.Buyer: John Knox (now residing in Calif.); $4000 stated price but allottee received only $10 with balance applied to debts
extraction.Occupation/Income: $57.50 War Risk Insurance, received each month. Has small inherited interest. No contributions.
extraction.NOTES: Good health, no property or money accumulated. Two minor children dependent upon allottee. Allottee feels he was defrauded of his land, as he did not owe anything like $4000 to John Knox. Knox reported to be in fair circumstances. Document also contains a separate questionnaire for Moses Haragarra (Allotment No. 5), who is a different allottee. Notarized November 22, 1928, in Kay County, State of Oklahoma; notary commission expires Aug. 3rd, 1931. Both witnesses of Ponca City, Okla.
